title: Route request flow
subtitle: Positions travel in request bodies on our API and are never logged or stored. One attempt per request: a sleeping routing service answers 503 with Retry-After and the app tries again (P012b, ADR 0020)

nodes.label: App: POST /v1/routes with origin, destination and mode in the body, and a Firebase ID token
App shows 1 to 3 routes with the map credit, or a calm message; on 503 it waits Retry-After and asks again (P012c)
Validation: ranges, mode, points at least 20 m apart (400)
Rate limiter: burst 10, 300 per day, global budget (429, 503)
Extent check: both points inside the covered area, straight-line limit per mode (422 outside_covered_area, route_too_long)
ID token of the API's own account, audience = the service URL, cached until 5 min before expiry
OSRM adapter: one GET, timeout 25 s (not measured yet), no retry, answer size-limited and parsed
Mapped answer: 200 routes with bbox, 404 no_route_found, 422 location_not_routable, 503 routing_unavailable + Retry-After 10
One log line: outcome, latency, route count, mode. Never a position, a geometry or a URL
OSRM service for the mode: private, IAM invoker = the API only, may be asleep (scale to zero)
Its request log is excluded: OSRM takes coordinates in the URL path
